description:
fixture_metadata.rs is 475 lines whose entire import list is std::fmt and std::path::Path. It has no production consumer -- compiler2/mod.rs only re-exports it -- yet it is fully pub so tests/fixture_matrix.rs can reach it, and tests/ compiles against the lib as an external crate and cannot see cfg(test).

Move the module to its own workspace crate consumed as a [dev-dependencies] of fz. Lib unit tests (fixture_metadata_test, fixture_contract_harness_test) and tests/fixture_matrix.rs then share one copy. Cargo permits the dev-dependency cycle. Delete the re-exports from compiler2/mod.rs.

Done when: the crate exists, all consumers compile against it, no fixture-metadata symbol is reachable from the production lib, and the full gate is green.
title: Extract fixture_metadata to a dev-dependency crate
